details.name: ISO 19005-4:2020 - 6.2.4 Colour Spaces - 6.2.4.6 Rendering intents
details.description: Where a rendering intent is specified, its value shall be one of the four values defined in ISO 32000-2:2020, Table 69: RelativeColorimetric, AbsoluteColorimetric, Perceptual or Saturation
